field_principles.cross_game_ci95: Task-level bootstrap CI95 of the cross-game delta -- excluding 0 means the verifier generalizes to unseen games.
field_principles.cross_game_delta: BARE float: set_encoder@1 - vote@1 on HELD-OUT GAMES -- the real OOD lift; the load-bearing generalization number.
field_principles.held_out_game_n: BARE int: number of games never seen in training -- the OOD breadth; report alongside held_out_task_n for power.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A cross-game win, a within-game-only collapse, and a no-headroom are ALL COMPLETE and decision-grade for scoping the headline.
field_principles.model_specs: The game-disjoint split protocol + set-encoder config; required methodology.
field_principles.oracle_at_k: Positive-control ceiling on held-out games -- if ~=vote the cross-game null is uninformative, not a verifier failure.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the game-split + bootstrap reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the pool + game partition; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- learned set-encoder, no demo execution; keeps the transfer result oracle-distinct.
field_principles.within_game_minus_cross_game_gap: The .393 within-game +0.4423 minus cross_game_delta -- quantifies how much the win is per-game-basin memorization vs general signal.
